review_text: Good drinks and food, very affordable.

The person who caters to you is friendly and very accommodating. Which is very good so that you don't feel ugly. The service is good, the food is very good (some carbonara is delicious). The drinks really taste good, not to sweet nor no taste just right, which I love. The place is really nice, neat, pleasing and cool. Hoping for your branch shop to get bigger or have a second story extension. Many people have dined at them, because aside from being affordable, the service is delicious and nice.
